user_question: Can we solve the QNN path and get newer versions on Tachyon?
assessment: Actual full LFM350M generation is now proved on Tachyon v68 under both QNN2.47 and QNN2.51, in isolated Ubuntu24 userspaces. Newer QNN2.50 also executes a small neural graph on the unchanged native OS. The larger LFM2.6 NPU export remains untested.

research_correction.qualification: The earlier no-ready-path finding was too broad beyond the official/upstream paths examined. Community v68 ONNX/QNN exports exist for LFM2.5-350M and Qwen3.5-0.8B. Their published results require independent Tachyon validation; this does not establish LFM2.6 QNN compatibility.
